title: Physical-Measure Merton Jump-Diffusion Calibration Surrogates and Direct Realized Volatility Forecasting: An Empirical and Numerical Audit on S&P 500 ETF (SPY) Returns
idea: Train a hybrid LSTM on recent NQ range, 30‑day IV, and realized volatility (l_rng, l_iv30, l_rv20) to predict the next 21‑day realized volatility (y_r) and use it to size option positions.
